baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated verb at 91:15.2 governs the feminine-marked outcome noun at 91:15.3.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fear is prospective anticipation, while the object names what an unspecified feminine event eventually leaves or produces.

activation_trace.role: Anticipated harm makes the negation prospective rather than merely describing calm after an event.
The terminal result of an act supplies the feared object as its eventual aftermath.

changed_reading.before: The clause merely says that an unnamed subject is not afraid.
changed_reading.after: The subject does not anticipate harm from the event's eventual aftermath.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same verb-object construction can narrow the outcome at 91:15.3 to a retaliatory consequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The outcome is not neutral futurity but adverse requital arriving after a deed, so the denial concerns deterrence or exposure to punishment.

activation_trace.role: Expectation of harm supplies the deterrent force that the negation removes.
Punitive consequence after an offense turns a generic result into retaliatory requital.

changed_reading.before: The subject has no anxiety about a generic result.
changed_reading.after: The subject is undeterred by, or unexposed to, punitive requital after the deed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The outcome noun at 91:15.3 remains rooted in what follows after, including a reviewing or reversing follower.
baseline_models.mechanism: What comes afterward can be a claimant, review, or attempt at reversal; negated fear then describes an act performed without apprehension of later challenge.

activation_trace.role: Prospective apprehension supplies the subject's possible exposure to a later challenger.
Following up to question, claim, or reverse supplies an institutional rather than merely emotional aftermath.

changed_reading.after: No later claimant, reviewer, or reverser is apprehended after the act.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated fear at 91:15.2 and the remaining wake at 91:15.3 can both be read as observable traces.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fear can manifest on a person, and an aftermath can be a residue; their pairing allows the clause to deny that the event leaves a legible mark of fear on the subject.

activation_trace.role: Visible manifestation shifts fear from an inner state to an outwardly readable sign.
A remaining residue supplies the wake in which such a sign could persist.

changed_reading.before: The subject does not internally feel fear of the result.
changed_reading.after: The event's wake leaves no visible residue of fear on the subject.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following, disclosure, and covering make the early context a sequence of alternating states. That sequence revises the aftermath from a single terminal result into the next turn that follows the present one.

activation_trace.role: Prospective harm supplies the possible anxiety directed toward the next phase.
Coming after in succession turns the aftermath into a successor phase.
Following and sequence establish an explicit context model of one state arriving behind another.
Disclosure supplies one phase of the alternating mechanism.
A covering that rises over its object supplies the contrary phase that follows disclosure.

structural_cues: 91:1-4 repeatedly place feminine -ها objects inside ordered clauses, with following, revealing, and covering succeeding one another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered alternation; I infer that it makes the focus aftermath a next turn in the sequence. A live alternative is still a one-time punitive result rather than a recurrent phase.

changed_reading.before: The subject does not fear one event's terminal consequence.
changed_reading.after: The subject does not apprehend the next turn in an ordered succession of states.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired operations of making visible and covering over strengthen the focus-only trace model: the question is whether an aftermath exposes a fear-mark or leaves it concealed.

activation_trace.role: Fear appearing on a person provides the potentially visible mark.
Residual trace provides the temporal-material location where the mark would remain.
Uncovering and appearance activate the possibility that an inner state becomes legible.
Covering supplies the rival operation that can hide a trace without erasing it.

structural_cues: 91:3 and 91:4 apply opposed reveal-cover operations to the same feminine pronominal shape.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visibility and concealment plus focus branches for manifested fear and residue; I infer that the negation concerns a readable aftermath-mark. The live alternative is ordinary inward fear with no visual entailment.

changed_reading.before: The clause reports an unafraid inner state.
changed_reading.after: Even when aftermath makes states legible, no fear-mark appears or remains on the subject.

context_deltas.mechanism: Composition and the first fashioning establish differentiated form; the repeated fashioning root after extirpation can instead equalize. The focus aftermath then becomes a reversal that turns formed distinctions back into a level condition.

activation_trace.role: Anticipation of harm supplies the possible cost of reversing an earlier formation.
Turning back on the heel supplies the reversal geometry within the aftermath.
Joining parts into a construction supplies the initial production of ordered form.
Integrity and completion supply the first occurrence as fashioning a whole self.
Making things equal supplies the second occurrence as leveling distinctions.
Extirpation makes the later equalization materially destructive rather than merely formative.

structural_cues: The same surface pattern سواها occurs at 91:7 and 91:14, first near the self's formation and later after extirpation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies composition, two live branches of the repeated root, and extirpation; I infer a formation-to-leveling reversal. The repeated form could alternatively denote completion in both places without semantic reversal.

changed_reading.before: The subject does not fear a consequence external to the act.
changed_reading.after: The agent of leveling does not fear the aftermath of reversing formed distinctions into an equalized field.

context_deltas.mechanism: A breached limit and active protection are paired in the moral context. Their contrast revises fear from bare emotion into awareness of exposure and the need to shield oneself from what follows.

activation_trace.role: Expected harm provides the exposure against which protection would normally respond.
Punitive consequence specifies the backlash from which an exposed actor might seek protection.
Deviation that tears a protective boundary supplies the production of exposure.
Warding off harm supplies the active precaution that is distinct from merely feeling fear.

structural_cues: 91:8 coordinates the self's breach and protection as paired feminine possessions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies breach, protection, anticipated harm, and requital; I infer that fear indexes the need for precaution. If the subject is the offender, the negation is reckless exposure; if sovereign, it is immunity from exposure.

changed_reading.before: The subject simply lacks an emotion.
changed_reading.after: The subject does not occupy the vulnerable position that must shield itself from later backlash, whether through recklessness or immunity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Plowing, growth, and concealment activate the focus root's plant-stage branch. The aftermath becomes not an abstract verdict but a terminal material phase in which cultivated or buried growth yellows and dries.

activation_trace.role: Anticipated harm allows a terminal material stage to function as the feared prospect.
Plant yellowing toward dryness supplies a concrete terminal stage for the aftermath.
The plowman cutting the earth supplies cultivation as the beginning of the material sequence.
Growth and increase provide the flourishing middle phase.
Hidden insertion supplies burial or suppression before the terminal stage.

structural_cues: 91:9-10 form parallel success-failure clauses around opposed treatments of the same feminine object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cultivation, growth, concealment, and a plant-drying focus branch; I infer a life-cycle analogy across them. The stronger alternative keeps purification and corruption moral rather than ecological.

changed_reading.before: The aftermath is an abstract consequence.
changed_reading.after: The aftermath can be pictured as the withering phase that follows cultivated growth or its burial.

context_deltas.mechanism: Concealment, boundary-crossing, sudden self-rousing, and the singular wretched agent form an alternative subject chain. On this reading, the final singular describes the perpetrator's reckless refusal to be deterred by requital.

activation_trace.role: Prospective harm supplies the deterrence that the reckless agent lacks.
Punitive consequence supplies what should have checked the perpetrator's action.
Concealment supplies the suppression of what might otherwise remain morally visible.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the agent's transgressive momentum.
Rousing what was still supplies the abrupt launch into action.
Wretchedness supplies the singular candidate actor whose conduct remains undeterred.

structural_cues: The masculine singular agent at 91:12 can formally compete with the nearer masculine singular lord at 91:14 for the unexpressed subject of 91:15, though intervening plurals weaken the backward link.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a singular perpetrator and a final singular verb; I infer long-range subject continuity across the intervening narrative. The nearer lord is a materially stronger rival subject.

changed_reading.before: The clause leaves the unexpressed subject unidentified.
changed_reading.after: The most wretched perpetrator surges into the deed without fear of its punitive aftermath.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial and limit-crossing confront a delivered message, proceed to crippling violence, and are followed by extirpation explicitly tied to offense. This sequence turns the baseline punitive branch into a concrete offense-to-requital chain.

activation_trace.role: Anticipated harm supplies fear's deterrent orientation toward requital.
Punishment after wrongdoing supplies the legal-causal endpoint of the chain.
Attributing falsehood supplies deliberate rejection as the first actionable breach.
Transgressing a limit supplies the offense's excess beyond mere disagreement.
Messenger and message supply prior notice against which rejection and violation become legible.
Crippling an animal at its legs supplies the concrete violent deed.
Extirpation supplies the comprehensive adverse response.
Offense supplies the stated basis that links the violent act to the response.

structural_cues: The rapid ف-linked actions in 91:13-14 and the causal preposition in بذنبهم compress warning, violation, and response into one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies all nodes and a causal marker; I infer a juridical offense-to-requital arrow. A live alternative treats the sequence as overwhelming causal response without importing a courtroom model.

changed_reading.before: Punitive aftermath is only one lexical possibility.
changed_reading.after: The aftermath is the requital generated by a warned, boundary-crossing offense and its violent execution.

context_deltas.mechanism: A messenger's spoken designation joins a protected animal to an allocated watering share; the subsequent crippling violates that allocation. The focus outcome branch then activates as a claim or liability retained after the protected object is destroyed.

activation_trace.role: Anticipated harm supplies apprehension of an outstanding claim.
Substitution, retained property, and follow-up liability supply an obligation that survives the transaction or loss.
A saying that sets a thing's limit supplies the verbal definition of the protected arrangement.
The messenger and message supply authorized notice of the arrangement.
The concrete she-camel supplies the protected object to which the allocation attaches.
A share of watering and its channel supply the allocated resource-right.
Crippling the animal supplies the act that destroys the protected arrangement but leaves liability behind.

structural_cues: 91:13 places the animal and its watering share in parallel marked relations before 91:14 resumes the animal with a feminine object suffix.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authorized speech, a concrete animal, a watering allotment, violation, and a liability branch; I infer a protected resource-right. The arrangement could instead be ritual warning without a transferable legal claim.

changed_reading.after: The aftermath is an outstanding claim attached to a violated watering allocation, persisting after the protected animal is destroyed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearest singular lord is associated with sovereign mastery, extirpation, and comprehensive equalization. This context revises negated fear into the absence of any superior claimant able to review, reverse, or retaliate against the leveling act.

activation_trace.role: Anticipation of harm supplies the exposure to reprisal that sovereignty negates.
A follower who reviews, challenges, or reverses supplies the absent appellate power.
Equalization supplies the scope of the sovereign act under possible review.
Extirpation supplies the act's comprehensive and irreversible force.
Mastery and sovereignty supply the nearest singular agent and the lack of a superior authority.

structural_cues: The explicit masculine singular lord in 91:14 is the nearest nominal candidate for the unexpressed masculine singular subject of 91:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a nearest singular sovereign agent and a focus branch of follow-up challenge; I infer that no higher reviewer can answer the act. The distant singular perpetrator remains a live but syntactically weaker subject.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified subject feels no fear about a result.
changed_reading.after: The sovereign agent's leveling is beyond appellate reversal, counterclaim, or retaliatory exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Interrupted posterity, extirpation, and the image of a tail or followers cluster around the final action. They activate the focus aftermath as a surviving continuation capable of answering back; the feared follow-on is absent because the chain has been cut.

activation_trace.role: Anticipated harm supplies the possibility that survivors could retaliate or renew the conflict.
Posterity left after a person supplies the possible surviving continuation.
A remainder or residual trace broadens posterity into any surviving after-part.
Interruption of offspring supplies a severed generational line.
Extirpation supplies the removal of a collective remainder.
Tails and followers supply the social body that would otherwise continue behind the destroyed group.

structural_cues: The final context verse clusters roots whose branch inventories repeatedly encode cutting, ending, extirpation, tails, followers, and what remains afterward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severed descent, extirpation, followers, posterity, and residue; I infer that a surviving body would be the feared aftermath. It does not state directly that no survivor remains, and offense-result remains the safer reading.

changed_reading.before: The subject does not fear an abstract consequence.
changed_reading.after: The subject does not fear a surviving descendant, follower, or remnant coming after the destroyed body.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers a moral-narrative clause into a plant life cycle and uses a form-distant focus branch. It remains anchored in the focus outcome root and in context branches for plowing, growth, and concealment; downstream prose should call it an ecological analogy, not replace the ordinary sense of aftermath with literal vegetation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The terminal plant-stage branch of the outcome root at 91:15.3 supplies a concrete image for what follows.

activation_trace.role: Yellowing toward dryness supplies the surprising terminal image.
Plowing the earth supplies the start of a cultivation sequence.
Growth supplies the phase whose later decline becomes meaningful.
Concealed insertion supplies burial or suppression in the material analogy.

changed_reading.after: The aftermath briefly appears as the drying terminal phase of something cultivated, grown, and then buried.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins a non-dominant split mapping for the watering root to movement and pursuit. It remains anchored in the focus heel-trace and follow-up branches plus context images of dispatch and single-track following; downstream prose should mark it as a kinetic overlay, not claim that the watering expression lexically means pursuit.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The rear-trace and follow-up branches at 91:15.3 permit an aftermath to be personified as someone arriving on the subject's heels.

activation_trace.role: Expected harm supplies apprehension of a pursuer coming from behind.
Heel and rear trace spatialize the aftermath as movement immediately behind.
A pursuing claimant supplies the agent who follows the trace.
Dispatch and direction supply the launching of a moving agent.
Sending and setting in motion reinforce the dispatched-agent pattern.
The non-dominant mapped branch of following one trace supplies the kinetic bridge to pursuit.

changed_reading.before: The subject fears no impersonal aftermath.
changed_reading.after: The subject fears no pursuer or claimant dispatched to come immediately on the act's heels.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats the aftermath as a surviving social body rather than an event. It remains anchored in the focus posterity and residue branches and in context branches for interrupted offspring, extirpation, and followers; downstream prose should present it as an annihilation-induced inference, since survival or its absence is not stated directly.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Posterity and remainder branches at 91:15.3 allow the feminine aftermath to include what or who remains behind.

activation_trace.role: Posterity supplies descendants as a living aftermath.
Residue supplies non-genealogical remnants alongside descendants.
Interrupted offspring supplies the cutting of posterity.
Extirpation supplies the removal of a remainder at collective scale.
Followers imagined as tails supply the social continuation behind a body.

changed_reading.before: The aftermath is what happens later.
changed_reading.after: The aftermath is who remains later: descendants, followers, or residue capable of answering the act.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form denotes outcome while the activated branch pictures a difficult mountain pass, and the context link comes through a split hardship root. It remains anchored in the focus root and the context's long mountain-ascent branch; downstream prose should qualify it as spatial metaphor for consequential difficulty, not a claim that the verse names a literal pass.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The steep-pass branch of the outcome root at 91:15.3 spatializes what follows as difficult terrain.

activation_trace.role: Anticipated harm supplies apprehension before entering difficult terrain.
A steep and jutting pass supplies the spatial image of a hard aftermath.
A long upward mountain flank supplies the context bridge from hardship to ascent.

changed_reading.after: The consequence is also spatially ahead: a steep passage whose difficulty does not deter the subject.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it converts fear into a visible sign and aftermath into its residue. It remains anchored in explicit focus branches and in context operations of revealing, covering, and marking; downstream prose should describe a visual diagnostic overlay rather than deny the ordinary inward sense of fear.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The manifestation branch at 91:15.2 and residue branch at 91:15.3 jointly permit an outward fear-trace.

activation_trace.role: Fear appearing on a person supplies an outward diagnostic sign.
Residue supplies the enduring trace in which that sign could be read.
Revelation and appearance supply the act of making the sign visible.
A concealing cover supplies the contrary possibility of obscuring the sign.
The non-dominant mapped image of a visible identifying mark sharpens the aftermath as legible evidence.

changed_reading.before: Fear is only an inward state.
changed_reading.after: Fear would be a mark exposed in the wake, yet the subject's aftermath carries no readable sign of it.

strongest_changes: Cosmic following and alternation revise a terminal aftermath into the next turn of a recurring sequence.
The breach-protection pair shifts fear from emotion toward vulnerability, precaution, and exposure to backlash.
The repeated fashioning root supports a formation-to-leveling reversal in which aftermath is the undoing of differentiated form.
The offense sequence strongly specifies the aftermath as requital, while the watering share further sharpens it into retained liability.
The nearest sovereign subject activates absence of review, but the earlier singular perpetrator preserves a rival reading of reckless non-deterrence.
summary.what_was_special: The focus clause remained stable enough to anchor several incompatible but live mechanisms: consequence, requital, appellate follow-up, cyclic succession, visible residue, surviving posterity, and spatial difficulty. Context especially changed who can be unafraid and whether that lack is sovereign immunity or culpable recklessness.
remaining_uncertainties: The unexpressed masculine singular subject can most readily continue the nearby lord, but a longer backward link to the singular perpetrator remains grammatically imaginable.
The feminine suffix can gather the leveling act, its result, or a broader feminine chain; the packet does not force one antecedent scope.
The formation-leveling reversal depends on assigning different live branches to two occurrences of the same form.
The ecological, visible-mark, steep-pass, posterity, and split-mapping pursuit readings are intentionally branch-distant and should remain qualified rather than synthesized as primary senses.
